newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: EU suspends beef package talks until 1400 GMT.
newsitem.headline: EU suspends beef package talks until 1400 GMT.

text.p: Farm ministers suspended talks on a beef package until 1400 GMT on Wednesday after giving a generally favourable reaction to a new compromise text from the Irish Presidency, EU officials said.
The text called for 500 million Ecus extra aid for farmers hit by the mad cow crisis and modified measures to reduce beef surpluses.
"There is the basis for a deal," Commission spokesman Gerard Kiely said.
But he warned that there was no new money available in the 1997 budget and agreement on the allocation of the extra aid between member states would be difficult.
"It (the new text) is negotiable," a French official said.
On Tuesday French Farm Minister Philippe Vasseur, along with other ministers, had rejected the first presidency compromise as totally unacceptable because it provided for no new aid.
